timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Work is still running through my mind.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep thinking about what is unfinished.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am worried I forgot something important.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Part of me is still at my desk.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body has not left work mode.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel responsible for keeping everything moving.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: It is hard to stop when there is more to do.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit I am still carrying work.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This pressure followed me into bed.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: The workday is allowed to end.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Unfinished does not mean unsafe.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can write it down and return tomorrow.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not need to be available every moment.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can leave work mode now.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Rest will help me think more clearly.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can care about my work without carrying it all night.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: Tomorrow has space for the next step.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can put work down for now.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am off the clock in this moment.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My value is bigger than my productivity.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to return tomorrow.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can be present in my life outside work.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is ready to rest.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I have done enough for today.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Boundaries help me do sustainable work.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: Tonight belongs to me.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to sleep.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
